manifest_replacement.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Replace this exact box drawing with ONE finely detailed realistic historical Ming Jiangnan one-storey house. Preserve EXACTLY the camera and the three visible ground vertices of the input; do not invent a different viewpoint, do not enlarge or move footprint. On square image ground L=(132,645), front=(541,850), right=(892,675); the front is only slightly right of center. BOTH ground edges 26.565 degrees. Ground front width7 depth6, equal pixels per metre. Put a wood lattice door and a shuttered window in left white plaster wall, plain white gable on right, a charcoal fired-clay tiled pitched roof on top, gently upturned ends, pale narrow grey stone perimeter. Fine believable weathered clay tiles, lime plaster and chestnut wood grain, matte realistic Chinese historical game sprite, soft light from upper left. Do not shift the front base corner to the right. Keep full thin base parallelogram with 7:6 ratio. Backdrop must become TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, object fully opaque, no haze, only tiny contact shadow. Delete all outlines and grey background, do not include drawing, text, labels, people or scenery. Single building cutout, spacious margin. This is architectural texture rendering of the locked geometry, not free reinterpretation.
